details.trial_plan: In an isolated temporary Git repository with text eol=lf, stage CRLF JSON and demonstrate mismatch; write LF JSON and restage, then require identical worktree/index bytes.
details.counterexample: Do not rewrite historical events or unrelated files. Binary evidence and signed bytes may require a different Git attribute contract.
details.when: Windows-generated new JSON evidence in repositories with Git newline normalization and exact-byte evidence gates.
details.method: Generate new evidence with explicit UTF-8 LF, stage it, then compare worktree bytes with the indexed blob before running the expensive full gate.
